# Challenge 6: find the last dynamically loaded class

The app loads a library on demand. Find the exact class the app loads last
after pressing Load Plugin, and prove it was loaded dynamically, not
at startup.

**Hints**:

<details>
<summary>Hint 1</summary>

The class monitor reports what loads between drains.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 2</summary>

The app's `loadDynamicLib` method uses `Class.forName` for one class and
`System.loadLibrary` for the other.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 3</summary>

`DynamicTrigger` is never referenced statically in the dex.
</details>

[Watching class loads](../android_journey/watching_class_loads.qmd) is the
matching chapter.
